description: A Flutter widget representing a screen that displays a restaurant's menu, fetched from a provider, with functionality to add items to the cart.

classes.name: RestaurantMenuScreen
classes.description: Screen widget to display restaurant menu, allow adding items to cart.

classes.name: _RestaurantMenuScreenState
classes.description: State class managing menu fetching, loading state, and UI rendering.

methods.description: Initializes state and triggers menu fetch.

methods.name: build
